description: Video Guide Skill — OpenAI-compatible function-calling definitions (Codex, Grok Code, Muse Code, Agents SDK). End user supplies ONLY video_path (and optional flow notes). Agent extracts 3 FPS frames, analyzes all frames, reads storyboards via vision, writes recipe, validates plan, and renders MP4.

function.name: create_guide
function.description: Start the automated video-guide pipeline when the user provides a screen recording video path. Extracts 3 FPS frames via FFmpeg (e.g., ~630 frames for 210s), analyzes ALL extracted frames, renders labeled Storyboard Contact Sheets, and emits a starter engine.py recipe_draft.json. Inspect all storyboards and key frames BEFORE finalizing the recipe.

user_flow_notes.description: Optional editing instructions/flow notes from user.

function.name: extract_frames
function.description: Extract N-FPS frames from a video using bundled FFmpeg (default 3 fps).

function.name: analyze_frames
function.description: Analyze ALL extracted 3-FPS frames (`0 .. N-1`), segment UI transitions / actions / idle holds, detect active UI bboxes, and generate Storyboard Contact Sheets.

function.name: inspect_frame_slice
function.description: Generate a dense contact sheet of consecutive frames [start_frame .. end_frame] to zoom into fast UI interactions.

function.name: validate_recipe
function.description: Verify no [AGENT:] placeholders remain and run `engine.py --plan_only` for TTS & overlap checks.

recipe_path.description: Path to saved recipe.json on disk.

function.name: render_guide
function.description: Render complete narrated, HUD-annotated MP4 + SRT captions via engine.py.

recipe_path.description: Path to completed recipe.json on disk.

executor.python: from tool_executor import create_guide; res = create_guide('C:/rec.mp4')
